name: Ecommerce and retail
description: Marketplace, DTC, and retail catalog sites.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AOV
hasDefinedTerm.description: Total revenue divided by number of orders. What a typical customer spends per purchase.

hasDefinedTerm.name: LTV
hasDefinedTerm.description: The total revenue expected from a customer across the whole relationship.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CAC
hasDefinedTerm.description: The total sales and marketing spend required to acquire one new customer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: ROAS
hasDefinedTerm.description: Revenue generated per unit of ad spend. A channel efficiency measure.

hasDefinedTerm.name: contribution margin
hasDefinedTerm.description: Revenue less all variable costs, including fulfilment and returns. What a sale actually leaves behind.

hasDefinedTerm.name: cart abandonment
hasDefinedTerm.description: When a shopper adds items then leaves without buying. Tracked as a percentage of carts created.

hasDefinedTerm.name: checkout abandonment
hasDefinedTerm.description: Leaving after starting checkout rather than at the cart. Usually a friction or trust problem, not a pricing one.

hasDefinedTerm.name: repeat purchase rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of customers who buy more than once. The clearest early signal of retention.

hasDefinedTerm.name: returns rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of orders sent back. A direct drag on contribution margin.

hasDefinedTerm.name: sell-through rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: Units sold as a share of units received in a period. An inventory efficiency measure.

hasDefinedTerm.name: attach rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: How often an accessory or add-on sells alongside a primary product.

hasDefinedTerm.name: GMV
hasDefinedTerm.description: Gross merchandise value. Total sales value transacted, before fees, returns, or discounts.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SKU
hasDefinedTerm.description: A unique identifier for one distinct sellable item, including its size and colour variant.

hasDefinedTerm.name: GTIN
hasDefinedTerm.description: A global trade item number identifying a product across retailers. Required for many shopping feeds.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MPN
hasDefinedTerm.description: Manufacturer part number. Identifies a product as the maker designates it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: variant
hasDefinedTerm.description: A version of a product differing by one attribute such as size or colour. A frequent duplicate-content source.

hasDefinedTerm.name: parent product
hasDefinedTerm.description: The grouping record that variants belong to. Usually the URL you want indexed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: product feed
hasDefinedTerm.description: A structured file of catalog data submitted to shopping channels so they can list your items.

hasDefinedTerm.name: category taxonomy
hasDefinedTerm.description: The hierarchy products are organized into. Drives both navigation and crawl efficiency.

hasDefinedTerm.name: attribute enrichment
hasDefinedTerm.description: Filling out product attributes so items are filterable, comparable, and retrievable.

hasDefinedTerm.name: catalog hygiene
hasDefinedTerm.description: Keeping titles, attributes, images, and availability accurate across a large catalog.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PIM
hasDefinedTerm.description: Product information management. The system holding canonical product data feeding storefronts and channels.

hasDefinedTerm.name: out of stock
hasDefinedTerm.description: An unavailable item. How you handle the page matters: keeping and updating it usually beats removing it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: backorder
hasDefinedTerm.description: Accepting an order for stock not yet held, to be fulfilled on arrival.

hasDefinedTerm.name: discontinued product
hasDefinedTerm.description: An item no longer sold. Redirect to the nearest replacement rather than returning a 404.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PDP
hasDefinedTerm.description: The page for a single product, carrying its description, images, price, and availability.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PLP
hasDefinedTerm.description: A page listing multiple products, usually filterable and paginated.

hasDefinedTerm.name: collection page
hasDefinedTerm.description: A curated grouping of products, often built for a theme or campaign rather than the core taxonomy.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Product schema
hasDefinedTerm.description: Structured data describing an item's price, availability, and reviews, enabling enriched shopping results.

hasDefinedTerm.name: review schema
hasDefinedTerm.description: Structured data exposing ratings and reviews, commonly rendered as stars in results.

hasDefinedTerm.name: UGC
hasDefinedTerm.description: Reviews, photos, and questions contributed by customers. Cheap, distinctive content that is hard for competitors to copy.

hasDefinedTerm.name: buying guide
hasDefinedTerm.description: Editorial content helping a shopper choose between options. Captures upper-funnel intent that product pages cannot.

hasDefinedTerm.name: merchandising
hasDefinedTerm.description: Deciding which products surface where, in what order, to steer discovery and margin.

hasDefinedTerm.name: marketplace
hasDefinedTerm.description: A platform selling third-party inventory alongside or instead of its own.

hasDefinedTerm.name: dropshipping
hasDefinedTerm.description: Selling goods fulfilled directly by a supplier, so the retailer never holds stock.

hasDefinedTerm.name: 3PL
hasDefinedTerm.description: Third-party logistics. An outside provider handling warehousing and fulfilment.

hasDefinedTerm.name: fulfilment
hasDefinedTerm.description: Picking, packing, and shipping an order after it is placed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: last mile
hasDefinedTerm.description: The final delivery leg to the customer. Usually the most expensive part of shipping.

hasDefinedTerm.name: BOPIS
hasDefinedTerm.description: Buy online, pick up in store. A fulfilment option blending ecommerce and physical retail.

ctx.expansion: Buy online, pick up in store

hasDefinedTerm.name: inventory turnover
hasDefinedTerm.description: How many times stock is sold and replaced in a period.

hasDefinedTerm.name: stockout
hasDefinedTerm.description: Demand arriving with no inventory to meet it. Costs the sale and often the customer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: safety stock
hasDefinedTerm.description: Buffer inventory held to absorb demand variability and supplier delay.

hasDefinedTerm.name: price parity
hasDefinedTerm.description: Keeping a product's price consistent across the channels you sell on.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MAP
hasDefinedTerm.description: Minimum advertised price. A supplier-set floor on the price resellers may display.

hasDefinedTerm.name: dynamic pricing
hasDefinedTerm.description: Adjusting price automatically in response to demand, competition, or inventory.

hasDefinedTerm.name: markdown
hasDefinedTerm.description: A permanent price reduction, usually to clear ageing inventory.

hasDefinedTerm.name: basket analysis
hasDefinedTerm.description: Studying which products are bought together to inform bundling and recommendations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: subscription commerce
hasDefinedTerm.description: Selling on a recurring schedule rather than one purchase at a time.

hasDefinedTerm.name: loyalty program
hasDefinedTerm.description: A structured incentive rewarding repeat purchase.

hasDefinedTerm.name: chargeback
hasDefinedTerm.description: A forced reversal of a card payment initiated by the cardholder's bank.

hasDefinedTerm.name: payment gateway
hasDefinedTerm.description: The service authorizing and processing card payments at checkout.

hasDefinedTerm.name: BNPL
hasDefinedTerm.description: Buy now, pay later. Instalment financing offered at checkout.

hasDefinedTerm.name: headless commerce
hasDefinedTerm.description: Separating the storefront presentation layer from the commerce backend, connected by APIs.

hasDefinedTerm.name: omnichannel
hasDefinedTerm.description: Treating online, mobile, and physical retail as one continuous customer experience.

hasDefinedTerm.name: agentic commerce
hasDefinedTerm.description: Purchases discovered, negotiated, or completed by an AI agent acting for a shopper.

hasDefinedTerm.name: conversational commerce
hasDefinedTerm.description: Selling through chat, messaging, or assistant interfaces rather than a browsing storefront.
